title: Pan-Seared Sardines with Kenyan Skewer Salad
description: A French-inspired dish featuring pan-seared sardines served with a refreshing salad made with Kenyan-style skewers.
instructions: Preheat a non-stick skillet over medium-high heat.
Season the sardines with salt and pepper.
Add olive oil to the skillet and swirl to coat.
Sear the sardines for 2-3 minutes on each side, until golden brown.
Remove the sardines from the skillet and set aside.
In the same skillet, add the Kenyan skewers and cook for 1-2 minutes, until lightly toasted.
In a separate bowl, whisk together lemon juice and a pinch of salt.
To assemble the salad, place the cooked skewers on a plate, top with a sardine, and drizzle with lemon juice.
Garnish with chopped parsley and serve immediately.
